events.command:
git add pricing_cache.py && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
Raise pricing cache TTL to 1h and drop snapshot fallback

Extend CACHE_TTL_SECONDS from 900 to 3600 so cached pricing entries
stay valid across a full feed cycle instead of expiring between
refreshes.

With the longer TTL, entries no longer lapse while a feed run is late,
so the lookup() helper that served the previous snapshot as a stale
fallback is no longer needed and is removed. It has no callers in this
repo.
EOF
git log -1 --format='%H%n%s%n%n%b'; git status --short
